fusions.name: Pounce and Rake
fusions.desc: Springs you to a target up to 6 tiles away for a weapon strike that deals 12 damage and makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: First Blood
fusions.desc: Throws a javelin that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with 50% more critical chance against an unwounded enemy.

fusions.name: Close on Soft Feet
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later and you move 17% faster. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Claw in Reserve
fusions.desc: Each time you inflict a condition on an enemy, your next strike has 30% more critical chance. Once every 6 seconds.
